name: Donna Wakefield
researchKeywords: palliative care access, advanced lung disease, mesothelioma, socioeconomic inequalities
bio: Donna Wakefield has worked as an NHS doctor since 2008 and has been a Consultant in Palliative Medicine since 2019. She is a Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh and an NIHR Doctoral Fellow.
researchFocus: Donna's PhD examines inequalities in access to palliative care for people with advanced lung disease, including lung cancer, mesothelioma, COPD and interstitial lung disease. She is particularly interested in improving care for people with mesothelioma in socioeconomically deprived areas.

professionalRoles.title: Elected member, Research and Ethics Committee
